description: Unit tests for the CTObjectsExtractor component in Chromium's network certificate verification, including SCT extraction, verification, and OCSP response parsing.

classes.name: CTObjectsExtractorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing certificate transparency object extraction and verification.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test certificates and log verifier before each test.

methods.name: ExtractEmbeddedSCT
methods.description: Extracts an embedded Signed Certificate Timestamp (SCT) from a certificate.

methods.name: ExtractPrecert
methods.description: Extracts a precertificate signed entry from a chain.

methods.name: ExtractOrdinaryX509Cert
methods.description: Extracts a standard X.509 certificate entry.

methods.name: ExtractedSCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies that an extracted SCT correctly verifies the precertificate.

methods.name: ComplementarySCTVerifies
methods.description: Verifies that an externally provided SCT verifies the X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponse
methods.description: Parses SCT list from a fake OCSP response.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesSerial
methods.description: Checks SCT extraction failure when serial number does not match.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponseMatchesIssuer
methods.description: Checks SCT extraction failure when issuer ID does not match.
